Mic201-MSIM
Sir is decent, but unar class RA 8 am e thakay, most of the students were half asleep and didn’t gave a shit about what he said. He yaps a lot about all the experiences he had and talks in depth about the topics (which may seem irrelevant sometimes). The worst part is uni pura 1.5 hour class nei and sometimes even crosses that too. It sucked for me cause amr por por 2 ta class thakay, coffee khawar time o paitam nah barely. About his questions, he takes best 2/3 quizzes and the quizzes are easy just ek dui ta questions ektu ghurano dei like u will be confused those jate full marks ta keo easily nah pay rki. Quizzes are mainly mcq and tf. And he will take one mid term and there will broad questions and a set of quiz. All of the exams are only from the slides. But he doesn’t give marks generously for the theoretical questions in midterm and finals. In fact, onk marks kate bhai, tmi nije dekheo shocked hoye jaba je eto bhalo likha r por o kmne marks katlo. Literally mid e 25.9 dse, and ei .1 number o curve kore dei nai. Like he gives marks very weirdly. And about his slides, short and concise e hoy but onkkkk infos, plus uni mid r final er syllabus onk boro dei. Literally he gave 13 fucking lectures for finals and shb gula te eto infos chilo je, you might even start hallucinate in your dreams about it ngl. Sample questions dbe but guarantee nai je 100% oikhane thekei common ashbe but yeah common ashe sample theke.
Lastly, finals er por uni onk weird kaaj korse. Like koyekjon ke curve korse and koyekjon ke kore nai. Like amr friend er B+ type er grade ashtesilo, oke smh A dse. And amr mid er result bhalo chilo and kinda A- type er result ashtesilo and i thought je ek grade tw curve korbe, but no brooo!!! Amk A- e dse and didn’t curve even a single grade. (I aced the finals Ik that). Jai hok uni jehetu JU r faculty er theke beshi expect o kori nah kichu.
Best part about his classes were he never gave a shit who attended it. Like if u wanna attend, you are his guest fs but if u don’t taile card punch kore chole jaite prba ( but don’t make it that obvious rki). Class e jodi kotha nah bolo, you are good to go for him.
Overall,
7/10 (biased curving er jonno)
